weapon.d:
Grants Atk+3. Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.
At start of turn, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants the following effects to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn: Atk/Def+6, "neutralizes 'effective against flying' bonuses," and "neutralizes foe's bonuses during combat."
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res = number of foes within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit × 3, + 5 (max 14), deals damage = 10% of unit's Atk (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 10% of unit's Atk during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Atk.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Atk.

b.d: At start of combat, if unit's Spd ≥ foe's Spd-10, inflicts penalty on foe's Atk/Def during combat = 30% of difference between Def stats (unit's Def minus foe's Def) before combat. (Maximum penalty of -3.)

At start of combat, if unit's Spd ≥ foe's Spd-10, inflicts penalty on foe's Atk/Def during combat = 40% of difference between Def stats (unit’s Def minus foe's Def) before combat. (Maximum penalty of -5.)

At start of combat, if unit's Spd ≥ foe's Spd-10, inflicts penalty on foe's Atk/Def during combat = 50% of difference between Def stats (unit’s Def minus foe's Def) before combat. (Maximum penalty of -7.)

c.d: Inflicts Atk/Def-2 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Def-3 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Def-4 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
